stx.text: Strixhaven is the university on Arcavios that the Founder Dragons created after growing angry at mortals harnessing magic and deciding that disciplined study was needed, with Galazeth Prismari proposing they found it.
In Strixhaven: School of Mages, Extus Narr stands before his alma mater, commands the mage hunters to unfold, and orders the Oriq to attack, so that Strixhaven's heart is left undefended.
The dragons arrive and burn the mage hunters to ash, while beneath the Biblioplex Will and Rowan Kenrith face Extus and the Blood Avatar, which kills Extus but gravely wounds Will.
A coalition of professors and planeswalkers led by Professor Vess defeats the Oriq.

sos.text: In Secrets of Strixhaven, the university's history is traced to the end of the Blood Age, when five elder dragons founded Strixhaven and each consolidated the study of two mana colors into a college.
The Phyrexian Invasion damaged the campus and killed many faculty, yet Strixhaven welcomed its first off-plane students the year after and set up the Path Ward to oversee Omenpaths and vet visitors.

New arrivals shape its present, as Quint returns by planeswalking onto the quad and persuades Dean Tullus to hire him as a temporary teaching assistant, while the Archaics, provoked into a destructive rampage, confront the school and its students.
